title: Email the patient from an alert
summary: Open the email with the rule's text, review it and send it.

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Send email
steps.details: Tap the alert's envelope (disabled if the patient has no email). Do it on the alert you want to work on.

steps.title: To
steps.details: The patient's email; if missing, it's entered on their record.

steps.title: Message
steps.details: It comes prepared with the rule's template; you can edit it before sending.
